general_lemmas_derived_since_cp058: End-vertex exclusion (generalizes span-2): for an end E of loop X with vertex z next to v, if X arrives at E at a non-cut corner followed by traversal Q1, and X^- (or X) leaves E at a non-cut corner preceded by P2, then label(z) is absent from HEAD(Q1) and from TAIL(P2).

Lambda-incident lemma (cut at a short-loop end, short loop starting there): windows give delta in{4,5,6}; partition H'(delta-1),K(10-delta),c10; the head of the traversal after Lambda's opposite traversal at that end is (K minus y_delta)+c10. delta6 and delta5 die by K4/K5 counts; delta4 survives only with c10 strictly inside that head.

delta4 saturation: then y_4 is interior in the second K path, all ten edges among K minus y_4 are used exactly once, H' K3 is saturated, and tau (short-copy position) is12 or13 (tau11 gives four edges on three H' labels). No further adjacency of two labels from K minus y_4, or two from H', may occur anywhere.
